detail: Unproven, not disproven. The lift is above zero but under the success number, and the final read has no more time. The day-30 kill number no longer applies: the final read scales only at the success number. The idea can come back as a bolder version.
action: Keep the nine-field form and put the $6K into the webinar program.
reason: The lift is +17.2%, with a range of +0.6% to +33.9%. The success number was +33%.
rule: The final read scales when the whole range is above zero and the lift is at least +33%. Anything else is Kill. There is no second Extend.
compare: The verdict compares the test group with the control group over the same days, as a lift. It does not compare either group with the baseline or with the success number as a value.
